accounting.dividends: as the engine handles them for the saved fixture

candidate.rule: long SPY when EMA50 > EMA200 of completed daily closes, else flat; target applies to the next session open; flat until 200 bars exist

control.name: SPY buy and hold
control.rule: fully invested over the same window

criteria.claim_limit: One year and a handful of position changes cannot establish an edge. Any outcome is descriptive.
criteria.integrity: shadow tracking-error status ok on every comparable day; at most 2 missing days, each explained by a recorded data outage
criteria.keep: candidate is not dominated by the control on net CAGR versus max drawdown at both 5bp and 10bp, AND its max drawdown is at most 30%, AND integrity holds
criteria.performance_materiality: differences under 1.0 percentage point of net CAGR or of max drawdown count as ties
criteria.retire: candidate is dominated by the control at both 5bp and 10bp

data.adjustment_and_feed: as configured by the runner at freeze time; any change voids the plan
data.source: alpaca_data_get via scripts/spy_shadow_run.py (completed daily bars, read-only)

known_limits: Evaluation glue that extends the engine with forward bars is not yet written and is not hash-frozen; it may not change the signal, costs or criteria.
Shadow records are hypothetical positions, not fills; slippage and fill quality are not measured by this cycle.
purpose: First sealed forward test of the pipeline and of a simple trend rule. Not a claim of edge.
